subject: Re: MAP & acceptance tests — finalizing exit gates and verification runbook
messages:

Subject: MAP outline & a couple of acceptance questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers look promising. Jake and I started sketching a MAP and want to lock down exactly what success looks like so our security and procurement teams can move forward. Two specific asks:

1) We need a concise list of acceptance tests your runtime will run during our 4-week pilot (smoke/regression/perf).
2) For exit gates, can you confirm the pass thresholds you recommend for latency P95, token concordance, and failure rate?

Our timeline: pilot start target 8/10, evaluation wrap 9/7. Procurement will only greenlight if acceptance criteria are clear.

Can you send a short runbook and a MAP spreadsheet we can attach to the SOW?

Thanks,

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP outline & a couple of acceptance questions

Hi Olivia —

Great questions. I’ve sketched a compact MAP and an acceptance-tests doc attached; below are the highlights so you have the essentials for procurement/security:

Pilot scope & timeline
- Pilot window: 2026-08-10 to 2026-09-07 (4 weeks)
- Goal: validate production throughput, latency SLOs, and retrieval/accuracy for our clinical Q&A workflow

Core acceptance tests (summary)
- Latency (P95) under production-matched concurrency: <= 300ms for 512-token requests
- Token concordance: model response match to golden set >= 92% (measured via our normalized edit-distance harness)
- Error/failure rate: < 0.5% of requests returning 5xx or timeouts
- Functional smoke: 50 representative prompts across clinical intents with no critical safety regressions

Exit gates (go/no-go)
- Go: ALL of the following met for 3 consecutive days in week 4: P95 latency <= 300ms, concordance >= 92%, error rate < 0.5%
- Conditional go (requires joint review): If one metric narrowly misses but no functional smoke tests fail, propose canary rollout with throttled traffic
- No-go: any safety-critical regression or repeated availability incidents (>=2 incidents causing >5min outages)

I attached: MAP_MedIQ_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners and dates) and acceptance-tests-compact.md (detailed test cases + measurement hooks). Ben and Marissa — please skim for anything missing re: canary/fallback flows.

Next step: I’ll walk Jake through the measurement instrumentation on Tues 8/5 (30m). Can we confirm that?

—
Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

[Attachments: MAP_MedIQ_v1.xlsx, acceptance-tests-compact.md]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP outline & a couple of acceptance questions

Camila / Marissa —

Looks good. A couple of operational notes to add to the MAP before we send to procurement:

- Measurement windows: make sure instrumentation uses a 15-min rolling window for P95 reporting (not a single-run snapshot).
- Fallback policy: include a specific fallback model (quantized lower-cost variant) and defined routing policy in case of sustained load. That helps procurement accept the risk.
- Evidence artifacts: capture CloudWatch/metrics export, sample request/response pairs (sanitized), and a SOC2 evidence pointer for audit teams.

I suggest one minor tweak to the wording of the conditional go: require a documented mitigation plan and timeline (<=72h) before allowing conditional go.

If you want, I can add a short paragraph in the MAP about billing credit for SLA misses (standard practice in pilot SOWs).

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@mediqhealth.com>

Subject: Re: MAP outline & a couple of acceptance questions

Camila — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement/security after reviewing the attachments:

1) Concordance: the "normalized edit-distance" approach is fine, but can you provide a short sample script (python) showing how you compute the metric so our QA can reproduce results?
2) Data handling: please confirm logs retained during pilot will be limited to metadata + sanitized response pairs; raw PHI will never be stored.
3) If we hit a no-go due to a safety regression, what’s the rollback SLA you offer?

We’re good to walk the instrumentation on 8/5 — 11am PT works for me. Also adding Marissa to the thread (if she wants to comment on playbook triggers).

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Director, Procurement
MedIQ Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@mediqhealth.com>, Jake Turner <jake.turner@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP outline & a couple of acceptance questions

Thanks Jake — answers inline and attaching a tiny reproducibility script and the updated MAP with Ben’s suggested tweaks.

1) Concordance script: attached is concordance_check.py (sanitized) — it normalizes whitespace, lowercases, computes Levenshtein distance, and reports percent match. We’ll run it against the golden set and include the code/output as evidence.

2) Data handling: agreed — pilot logs will be limited to request metadata (timestamp, client id, prompt hash), and sanitized request/response pairs. No raw PHI will be stored. We will also provide a short note in the MAP documenting retention policy (14 days, automatically purged) and proof of KMS key usage for encryption-at-rest.

3) Rollback SLA: for safety regressions we will immediately halt traffic (automatic) and aim to remediate or rollback to prior model variant within 24 hours. If remediation requires config or infra changes, we will share a mitigation timeline and an interim fallback (quantized variant) within 72 hours.

Next actions:
- Camila to run instrumentation walk (8/05 11:00am PT) — confirmed with Jake and Olivia.
- Camila/Ben to send final MAP + acceptance-tests to procurement by 8/09 (attached).
- MedIQ to confirm sign-off or open any blocking items by 8/12 to preserve pilot start date.

Please review the updated MAP_MedIQ_v1.xlsx and acceptance-tests-compact.md attached. If everything looks OK I’ll email the SOW attachment kit for procurement (credit terms and sample pilot SOW clause included).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
